value.actual_behavior:
The 200 response of POST /mcp/v1/register is documented as "schema": {} -- no
properties at all. The property api_key is described only on
APIKeyBootstrapResponse, which belongs to POST /auth/api-key, a different
endpoint an agent registering itself never calls.
value.description:
First: thank you for the security-scheme fix in the same file today. We re-
measured it before writing this and it holds -- every scheme referenced is now
declared. This is a different field of that document and does not undo it.
The gap is between two sentences on /build that only work together if the
schema describes the reply. The page tells a reader to save a named field out
of the registration response, and it tells ChatGPT users to import openapi-
public.json as a Custom GPT Action schema. An agent that does the second has
no description of the first: the success response of the one call the whole
onboarding starts with is an empty object.
Scope, stated so it is not read as more than it is: this report is about the
one endpoint /build points at, and the measured values above are about that
endpoint alone. Other routes in the file share the shape, but we have not
filed them here and no figure above covers them.
The ask is a response_model on POST /mcp/v1/register.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-register-response-undocumented] the field /build tells an agent to save is absent from the published schema for the call that returns it: 'api_key' is in no 2xx response of POST /mcp/v1/register, which describes 0 field(s)
    left: api_key
    right: []
    sources: {'page': '/build', 'schema': '/openapi-public.json'}
    population: {'described_fields': 0}

REPRODUCE:
  - GET https://cymetica.com/build -> the copy-paste prompt reads: Save the returned api_key and send it as X-API-Key on every call
  - GET https://cymetica.com/openapi-public.json -> paths['/mcp/v1/register'].post.responses['200'].content['application/json'].schema == {}
  - Search the same document for api_key -> it occurs as a property only under components.schemas.APIKeyBootstrapResponse, reached from POST /auth/api-key

AUTOMATED CHECKS (public repo: github.com/zakutana/qa-cymetica):
  tests/discovery/test_build_onboarding.py::test_register_response_documents_the_field_the_page_says_to_save

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
The response of the endpoint the onboarding depends on is described in the
schema the same page tells outside agents to import, including the field
/build instructs the reader to keep.
value.title: POST /mcp/v1/register documents an empty 200 schema, so the api_key /build tells agents to save is absent from the machine-readable contract
